desc_zh: 用于海报、广告画面及零售展示的绸面写真相纸，整卷50米，适合大幅面喷绘项目。
desc_en: Satin photo paper for posters, advertising graphics and retail displays. Supplied in 50 m rolls for large-format print projects.
seo_title_zh: 绸面写真相纸｜规格与批量供应｜YINZAOSUO
seo_title_en: Satin Photo Paper | Specifications & Trade Supply | YINZAOSUO
seo_description_zh: 用于海报、广告画面及零售展示的绸面写真相纸，整卷50米，适合大幅面喷绘项目。 支持批量采购、覆膜及国际运输询价。
seo_description_en: Satin photo paper for posters, advertising graphics and retail displays. Supplied in 50 m rolls for large-format print projects. Enquire about trade quantities, lamination and international shipping.

detail_zh.lead: 绸面写真相纸适用于希望减少强烈镜面反光、呈现柔和表面效果的海报和展示画面。
finishing: 可选冷裱膜（亮膜或哑膜）
默认采用卷装交付，具体包装按订单确认
delivery: 默认卷装，内置硬质纸筒保护
可按需求另行确认纸箱包装
生产通常约2天，工厂备货及发出一般不超过一周
海运运输时间约40天，实际以航线、货代及清关安排为准
detail_zh.artwork: 请提供印刷文件、成品尺寸、数量、卷装或裁切要求及目的地。可先核对文件尺寸和出血设置。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供材料类型、宽度、数量或面积、是否覆膜、油墨选择、包装要求及收货国家/地区。
detail_zh.caveat: 产品规格以本页面列出的已确认参数为准。空运时效、运费、税费及最终交付时间需按目的地和货代方案单独确认。最低起订条件为100平方米，或订单货值超过USD 2,000（满足其中一项即可）。

detail_en.lead: Satin photo paper is suited to posters and display graphics where a softer surface appearance than a high-gloss finish is preferred.
finishing: Optional cold lamination in gloss or matte
Roll delivery is the standard format; confirm any special packing requirements
delivery: Standard roll packing with a rigid paper tube inside
Carton packing can be discussed as an alternative
Typical production is around 2 days; factory preparation and dispatch generally take no more than one week
Sea freight is approximately 40 days; actual transit depends on route, forwarder and customs arrangements
detail_en.artwork: Please provide print-ready artwork, finished dimensions, quantity, roll or cut-sheet requirements and destination. File dimensions and bleed can be checked before production.
detail_en.brief: Please specify the media type, width, quantity or area, lamination, ink option, packing requirements and destination country or region.
detail_en.caveat: Specifications are limited to the confirmed parameters listed on this page. Air-freight timing, freight charges, duties and final delivery dates must be confirmed for the destination and shipping arrangement. MOQ is 100 m², or an order goods value above USD 2,000; either condition is sufficient.
